Package eu.algites.lib.action.execution.transaction

Interface AIiTransactionActionExecutionRecord

public interface AIiTransactionActionExecutionRecord
Immutable transaction-owned record of a scheduled action, its execution outcome and its final effect after rollback. Does not flatten away subtransaction lineage.
